title: El caudillo
goal: Read about what a caudillo actually was, through Juan Manuel de Rosas — near-absolute legal power, a secret police, and colored ribbons that marked who could be trusted.

items: Explain what caudillo authority was based on, in contrast to formal institutions.
Explain what the 'suma del poder público' granted Rosas in 1835.
Describe what the Mazorca was and what the red ribbon signified.
Explain why historians still debate how to interpret Rosas.
Use impersonal se to define a term and describe a widespread practice.
